_comment: Recommended: shadow mode. AdGuard keeps port 53; ghost-dns scores its query log, so Ghostwall can never break DNS. To serve DNS inline instead, set shadow=false, restore dns_host/dns_port and point upstream at AdGuard on 5300 -- only after a week of clean shadow results.
_sinkhole_note: 0.0.0.0 = null route (client can't connect). Set to the Pi's LAN IP instead if you want blocked domains to hit a page on the Pi.
